estimates.anchor_source: No market on the line. Anchor = the repo's registered M7 below-EBITDA LIVE quantile for 4Q26 interest income (vintage 2026-09-11, point $170M, q10 $144M, T-bill 3.86 held flat, before the 16 Sep hike) -> P(<= 145.8) ~0.11. Adjacent markets: Kalshi KXFEDDECISION/KXFED 2026-09-17T08:21:21Z (Dec 2026 hike 25bp 0.69/0.70, cut <= 0.02; Dec upper bound > 4.00% 0.82/0.83); Polymarket 'Fed rate cut by January 2027' 0.14. Base rate: interest income fell >= 10% y/y in 0 of 6 quarters with the T-bill flat or up y/y (2Q23-2Q24). Decomposition: M7 rule Monte Carlo on the post-hike rate path with buyback-upsize and emergency-cut tails.
estimates.independence_note: M7's band is the h=2 Gaussian pool with cov80 = 1.00 (over-covering) and pre-dates the +25bp hike (~+$11M on the point); the decomposition re-centres on the post-hike path

model.conventions: object = income-statement 'Interest income', three months ended 31 Dec 2026, from the release table (else FY26 less 9M); 4Q25 base $162M as printed (FY25 $705M less 9M $543M); gross of interest expense

impact.note: Below adjusted EBITDA: no margin effect. At $145M vs the team path's $165M (-$20M; FY27 run-rate -$90M vs M7's $765M): 4Q26 EPS -$0.03, FY27 EPS -$0.13 (line-build sensitivity +/-100bp = +/-$0.28); stock -$2 at a cash-yield multiple. EV 0.05 x -2 = -$0.1/share: immaterial; rates are now a tailwind to this line, so the RNPL cash-timing point belongs on unearned fees (C12), not here.

sensitivity.assumption: 4Q26 T-bill -> 3.25 (emergency cuts as the base case)

monitoring.event: 3Q26 release: interest income ($184M rule), cash, funds held, buybacks, authorisation
monitoring.action: <= $165M -> 0.10; funds held y/y <= +5% -> +0.02; new >= $6bn authorisation with accelerated pace -> +0.05
